C0858.title: Triple Extortion Methods Amplify DDoS Attack Threats
C0858.summary: An analysis from November 2023 indicates that double extortion attacks have become common, involving network infiltration, sensitive data exfiltration, backup deletion, and data encryption. Triple extortion tactics have now emerged, adding further complexity by launching DDoS attacks against victims' critical infrastructure to extract ransom payments and intensify payment pressure.

references.title: Beyond the Ransom: Revealing the True Cost of Ransomware Attacks
